name: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Water and Climate
description: AI/ML fundamentals, exploratory data analysis, regression and classification problems in hydrology, decision trees and random forests, model interpretability, artificial neural networks, time series forecasting, deep learning – RNNs, LSTMs, convolutional neural networks, case studies on flood forecasting, climate downscaling, and satellite-based monitoring.
